<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="9LNQXArIAJgWW0UZXr8-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1043" dy="1097" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 Worker[\"School social worker\"]

 subgraph UI[\"Streamlit frontend\"]
 Start[\"Start a report\"]
 Entry[\"Enter session notes<br/>Type notes or upload a file\"]
 Extract[\"Review and correct<br/>extracted text\"]
 History[\"Browse saved reports<br/>Filter by student ID, school, grade,<br/>date of service, or status\"]
 Review[\"Review draft<br/>Show source notes and DAP sections side by side\"]
 Edit[\"Edit and save draft\"]
 Approve[\"Explicitly approve report\"]
 Download[\"Download approved PDF\"]

 Start --> Entry
 Start --> History
 Entry -->|\"Uploaded file\"| Extract
 Entry -->|\"Generate from typed notes\"| Review
 Extract -->|\"Confirm text and generate\"| Review
 History -->|\"Open a saved draft\"| Review
 History -->|\"Open an approved report\"| Download
 Review --> Edit
 Edit -->|\"Return to review\"| Review
 Review -->|\"Confirm approval\"| Approve
 Approve --> Download
 end

 subgraph API[\"FastAPI endpoints\"]
 Generate[\"POST /reports/generate\"]
 Get[\"GET /reports/{report_id}\"]
 Upload[\"POST /notes/extract\"]
 List[\"GET /reports\"]
 Save[\"PATCH /reports/{report_id}\"]
 Confirm[\"POST /reports/{report_id}/approve\"]
 PDF[\"GET /reports/{report_id}/pdf\"]
 end

 Worker --> Start
 Entry -.->|\"Upload file\"| Upload
 Upload -.->|\"Return extracted text\"| Extract
 Review -.->|\"Generate a new draft\"| Generate
 Review -.->|\"Load selected report\"| Get
 History -.-> List
 Edit -.-> Save
 Approve -.-> Confirm
 Download -.-> PDF",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
